||VM|| Server Back Up!



After the recent update that screwed over every single Gmod server, the unnofficial hotfix has been installed onto the server so you can play once again. Hopefully Valve will pull their finger out and fix it themselves soon.

We hope to see you on the server soon!

-The VentMob Team
